verdict.rationale: Kong documents the guardrail pieces this story needs. Its cost-management docs name budget enforcement and per-consumer spend limits as governance actions built on per-request cost figures. An AI Rate Limiting Advanced plugin exists, and AI traffic can be proxied with rate limits enforced. AI Auth Strategies attach inbound authentication to models and agents. However, the evidence never shows issuing a distinct key to an autonomous agent and binding budget and rate caps to that key, and the spend-limit mentions are brief rather than configuration-level docs. Missing for 10: explicit per-agent key/credential issuance, documented configuration of per-consumer token or cost budgets with hard cutoff, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
